parts: Last dot separates type only after a nonempty stem; one leading dot belongs to the complete stem; empty extension is valid
substitution: Standalone * preserves full name; stem-only patterns drop type; dotted patterns expand stem/optional extension independently; omit empty extension separator; repeated adjacent or separated stars reuse complete parts
selection: Existing exact/star/question/component/globstar matching; *.* still requires a dot; explicit backend domains and directory depths unchanged
admission: Capture once and preflight complete collision, alias, overlap, busy, byte/name rescan and quota checks before publication
bounds: 254-character paths, 32767 scanned entries, 64 MiB COPY snapshots, backend/device/pipe quotas and execution budgets
publication: Prepared logical state, retained rename byte/configuration identity and device garbage; rooted per-file errors can retain earlier changes
persistence: Resulting bytes/accounting only; no templates, scans, handles or pending plans
boundary: Portable path rules, fixed-width filename-question capture rules, directory question/bracket restrictions and plain pipe name syntax retained; no implicit discovery, directory creation, host transaction or native/controller/strict equivalence
